issues.text: Intended validation to reflect corrected input, but “Organisation is required” remains after valid “Totals Org”.

Validation errors clear when their corresponding contact values are corrected. — Steps 13-15 recorded that organisation and email errors remained visible after valid replacement values were entered, and all stale organisation, email, and phone messages were still visible when Continue was clicked with valid organisation/email and empty optional phone.

Users can select the Workshop ticket for an attendee. — The Workshop selection was directly attempted repeatedly in steps 20-28, but every recorded observation showed the ticket control still set to “Standard — $120,” with Bob not added as Workshop.
The Promo code textbox cannot be cleared with the standard fill interaction: after filling it with an empty value, it still displays TEAM15.
After Seats reserved is corrected to 2, the “must be between 1 and 12” error remains visible.

Rapidly clicking Save changes disables the button immediately, shows “Saving…”, and prevents duplicate save feedback. — After the first rapid-save click, the following snapshot used for step 9 still showed an enabled Save changes button and one existing confirmation; step 10 again records the button enabled and explicitly records no immediate “Saving…” label after the second-click attempt.
Stale “Enter a valid email address.” validation remains visible after email is corrected to alex@example.com.

Place order permits immediate duplicate submission: two rapid clicks with the same valid default billing data produced two receipts, BK-1001 and BK-1002, instead of exactly one receipt and one order r

Duplicate submission is not prevented: after the second Place order click, the page visibly shows a new confirmation, "Order BK-1002 confirmed.", and two receipts: "BK-1001 — $1002.90 to finance@north

The invalid card number "4242 4242 4242 4243" was accepted: submission displayed "Order BK-1003 confirmed." and added receipt "BK-1003 — $1002.90 to finance@northwind.test" instead of visibly rejectin
Invalid email customer@ is visibly accepted: confirmation and receipt BK-1003 are shown instead of an error.

Rapidly submitting a valid checkout twice creates exactly one receipt and one order reference. — After the first submission, step 3 observed receipt BK-1001; step 6 later records three receipts, BK-1001, BK-1002, and BK-1003, showing the duplicate valid submission produced BK-1002 rather than being prevented.

Submitting card number 4242 4242 4242 4243 with a valid-looking email visibly rejects the card and creates no order. — Step 5 confirms the requested invalid card was populated and submitted, but step 6 observes completed confirmation "Order BK-1003 confirmed." and a new BK-1003 receipt.

Submitting billing email customer@ with a populated card visibly shows an invalid-email error and creates no receipt. — Step 7 confirms customer@ was populated and submitted; the subsequent repeated Place order action in step 8 reports no page state change, with no validation feedback or receipt-blocking outcome observed after the attempted submission.

With Priority High, Open only enabled, and Search subject set to "invoice", the table shows “No tickets match” and status “Showing 0 of 8 tickets · 0 selected,” rather than showing Invoice total looks
After selecting all eight displayed rows individually, the footer reads “Showing 8 of 8 tickets · 8 selected” and every row checkbox is checked, but the header select-all checkbox remains unchecked.
Requester email text is rendered in very low-contrast light gray against the white table background.

With Priority High, Open only enabled, and subject search “invoice”, only Invoice total looks wrong remains and it is Open, with status “Showing 1 of 8 tickets”. — After enabling High and Open only, entering the search produced “Cannot reset password” as the sole remaining Open row in step 7, rather than Invoice total looks wrong; step 9 also observed Invoice total looks wrong as Closed.
Export CSV visibly downloads the agent report data. — Step 2 clicked Export CSV with domChanged=NO, and the immediate inspection recorded the report unchanged and no browser download list (step 3).

Send to stakeholders shows a visible success acknowledgement after it is clicked. — The control was clicked twice with domChanged=NO (steps 3-4), and the immediate observations state that no page feedback or page-level confirmation appeared.

Clicking Export CSV shows the visible confirmation “Export queued.” — Step 2 clicked Export CSV with domChanged=NO, and step 3 immediately recorded that the report remained displayed with no confirmation dialog or text.

Clicking Send to stakeholders shows the visible confirmation “Report sent.” — Step 3 clicked Send to stakeholders with domChanged=NO and no visible feedback was recorded; the final report state in step 4 still shows the unchanged report and export controls.
With Shift date set to 20/08/2026 and Assign to empty, clicking Book shift created a visible booking row reading "Thu, 20 Aug 2026 —". No visible assignee validation error appears.
Booking an assignee entered as "Probe" renders the name as formatted bold "Probe" in the booking list instead of displaying the literal markup text.

Submitting a valid-date booking with an empty assignee shows an assignee validation error and does not create a blank-name shift. — After the empty-assignee submission, step 8 observes no visible assignee error and a booking row `Thu, 20 Aug 2026 —`, proving a blank-name shift was created.

Submitting `Probe` as the assignee displays the markup literally rather than interpreting it as HTML. — Step 10 observes the markup booking's displayed name as `Probe` in bold, rather than the literal characters `Probe`.

Submitting with an empty Shift date and the default assignee shows a visible date error and leaves the booking area at `No shifts booked.` — Following the date-empty submission in step 12, the final snapshot in step 13 confirms `No shifts booked.` but explicitly records no visible date validation error.
Booking with Shift date 2030-07-14 and an empty Assign to field adds an incomplete booked row, “Sun, 14 Jul 2030 —”, instead of showing a visible assignee error and preventing the booking.

Submitting a date with no assignee shows validation and does not add an incomplete booked shift. — After clearing the assignee and clicking Book shift (steps 12-13), step 14 records two booked rows, including the incomplete row "Sun, 14 Jul 2030 —", so an incomplete shift was added.
Item and Movement selects expose concatenated option text instead of their visible labels as accessible names.
Quantity input has no accessible name despite the visible Quantity label.
Quantity input lacks an accessible name despite its visible Quantity label.

Washer 11mm can be changed to 59 using its own stepper and displays variance -1. — Repeated attempts to use the Washer minus control instead changed Hex bolt (steps 14, 16, and 17), while Washer remained 60 with an em dash; the requested Washer value of 59/-1 was never reached.

Submitting a changed audit shows confirmation content that reflects the changed item count or variance rather than only generic text. — With Hex bolt visibly changed to 139/-1 behind the modal, step 10 recorded the dialog title and a generic submission message; step 9 likewise recorded a generic submission dialog rather than changed-count details.

The confirmation dialog closes when the user uses Close, Escape, or clicks outside it, with both dialog and backdrop disappearing each time. — Step 2 attempted to close the reported open “Audit submitted” dialog but recorded the dialog still open in the observation, and Step 3 pressed Escape with domChanged=NO and no recorded dismissal.
